name: Diversity-weighted rank-fusion ensemble
tagline: Ten detectors (3 IForests + 3 KNNs + HBOS + COPOD + LODA + PCA) reduced to per-detector ranks; weights $\propto 1/\bar c_i$ from rank correlations.

key_hyperparams.name: fusion mix
key_hyperparams.role: blend of weighted-quadratic vs OR-style fusion

init_recovers: Equal-weight rank average if $\bar c_k$ all equal
diff_from_baseline: Goes beyond a single PyOD detector by stacking 10 diverse detectors and reweighting them by inverse rank correlation; final score combines a weighted quadratic-rank consensus with a max-rank sensitivity term.

name: Feature-stat adaptive IF/COPOD/KNN
tagline: Compute mean $|\rho|$ and $|\gamma|$ of $X$, then weight IForest, COPOD, k-NN accordingly and fuse robust z-scores via element-wise max.
diff_from_baseline: Adds a data-driven weighting on top of a 3-detector (IF/COPOD/KNN) ensemble using only feature-correlation and feature-skewness statistics, and fuses robust median/IQR-normalized scores by element-wise max.

name: Train-rank ensemble of IF + ECOD + COPOD
tagline: Convert each detector's test scores to its empirical training-rank in $[0,1]$, then combine rank-mean and rank-max as the final anomaly score.
init_recovers: Pure rank-mean if max-rank component is dropped
diff_from_baseline: Stacks 3 PyOD detectors via train-empirical rank conversion (search-sort against sorted train scores) and combines the average and max rank, instead of using one detector alone.

name: Purified copula tail-contrast ensemble
tagline: Map features through train ECDF, peel a low-tail core, then combine sparse-vs-dense tail, neighborhood tail-gap, Mahalanobis, PCA-residual and IForest via reliability-weighted z-scores.
init_recovers: Plain IForest fallback when core iteration fails
diff_from_baseline: Far beyond a single PyOD baseline: builds a 6-component, copula-domain, self-purified core ensemble with neighborhood tail-contrast, Mahalanobis, PCA-residual, two IForests and concentration-gated convex combination of `sparse' vs `diffuse' anomaly heads.

name: DARE: rank ensemble + GMM density
tagline: Rank-fuse ECOD, IForest, COPOD and PCA-space negative GMM log-likelihood, weighted by dataset size and consensus correlation, with a top-half harmonic-mean boost.
init_recovers: Equal-weight rank-mean if size buckets and HM boost are removed
diff_from_baseline: Combines ECOD/IForest/COPOD with a multi-component GMM density head in PCA space, applying size-bucketed base weights, consensus-corr rescaling, and a top-half harmonic-mean agreement boost.
